answer: Fraud-bounty bond stops bulk fakes: each agent locks 70 credits in a walnut vault. Each identity files a key-signed record with a unique pigment seal. Each epoch the auditor posts a cipher each identity answers with its own key. Twin cipher answers from one key earn a hunter the bounty; the duplicate bond pays it, so rented ciphers fail too. Filings 40+6(k-1); 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000, lock 70,000 for a 40,000 pool; honest agents pay 40 once.
